title: Quick start: your first Brief
description: This quick start takes one report/v1 brief through build, verify, publish, alias and serve, end to end on 127.0.0.1.

blocks.source:
mkdir -p dist
node src/cli.mjs build report.json --out dist/packet --receipt dist/build-receipt.json
node src/cli.mjs verify dist/packet

text: independently recomputes every digest and the content ID; it exits
on any mismatch and never repairs.

blocks.source:
node src/cli.mjs publish dist/packet --root dist/review-store --build-receipt dist/build-receipt.json
CONTENT_ID=$(node -p "require('./dist/packet/manifest.json').contentId")
node src/cli.mjs alias set first-brief "$CONTENT_ID" --root dist/review-store --expect-generation 0

blocks.text: Publishing the same bytes twice is a no-op; publishing different bytes under an existing content ID fails without touching the stored packet. An alias is a small mutable pointer outside the packet, updated by compare-and-swap on its generation — it never changes packet bytes.

blocks.source:
node src/cli.mjs service start --root dist/review-store --state-dir dist/service --port 8791
curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8791/healthz
open http://127.0.0.1:8791/a/first-brief/

text: is the human entry; the same alias at
is the byte-verified agent entry. Both 307-redirect (so they're never cached) to the immutable
